name: markdown
title: Markdown
description: A renderer that grows an answer in place as it arrives, turning hashes, dashes and backticks into a heading, numbered steps, syntax-highlighted code and a table. Content is split into blocks so parts already finished do not redraw.
use: Content arrives in pieces over the network and should read as finished prose as soon as each piece lands.
avoid: You only need plain text: it drags in marked, react-markdown, remark and shiki as dependencies.
a11y: Streamed updates have no live region, so screen readers are never told that new content arrived. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card holding left-aligned prose: a bold heading, a paragraph, a numbered list, a bordered code box with coloured syntax, and a two-column table with thin row rules. Text is small and grey on near-black.
behaves: Text arrives a few characters at a time and each chunk is parsed, so the heading, list, code block and table fill in from top to bottom. When the answer finishes the card empties and the same stream starts again.
customise: Pass the markdown string as children plus className for styling and optional react-markdown component overrides; the code-block theme and shiki languages need a source edit.
weight: moderate: Re-lexes each streamed chunk with marked and highlights code through shiki.
